done_when: A new repo from forge init and Forge's own forge.toml use gpt-6.1-terra at high effort for build, fix, lite and explore, and the guides say so

known.title: Sync Forge's checked-in adapters with the new defaults

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - opening Codex in Forge's checkout and invoking the explorer role.
The new configuration selects Terra high, but `.codex/agents/explorer.toml:4-5` still pins Sol medium, so the explorer continues using the old settings. This mismatch also causes `tests/test_subagent_roles.py:163-172`, which compares checked-in roles with freshly synced roles, to fail. Both checked-in Forge skills also retain the old defaults at line 1492. Regenerate and commit the adapters with `forge sync`.
findings.title: Sync Forge's checked-in adapters with the new defaults

stop.reason: forge sync refreshed the Codex explorer role to Terra high; the other roles use Sol high and stay

why: Forge's default Codex implementation model is gpt-6.1-sol at medium effort; the owner wants gpt-6.1-terra at high effort for build, fix, lite and explore (owner request 27 Oct 2026)
